subject: Order form commercial terms — minimum commits & invoicing cadence
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acmehealth.com>, Mark Reyes <m.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form commercial terms — minimum commits & invoicing cadence

Hi Samantha / Mark,

Thanks again for the time on Thursday. As promised, I'm following up with a concise summary of the commercial points we discussed for the Order Form to sit under the MSA (MSA already agreed in principle):

- Pricing schedule: Tiered unit pricing based on monthly committed GPU-hours (Committed Tiers A/B/C). We'll provide exact unit rates in the draft OF; pricing in USD.
- Minimum commits: Acme requested a smaller entry commit. Proposed compromise: 6-month minimum at Tier A credits (60% of estimated baseline), with option to revisit at month 4 for a partial step-down.
- Invoicing cadence: Redwood invoices monthly in arrears for consumed committed + overage usage.
- Net terms: Standard is Net 30. Acme asked for Net 45; we can accept Net 45 for the first 12 months for this pilot, then Net 30 thereafter.
- Taxes: Customer is responsible for all taxes (except Redwood income taxes). Redwood will add tax as a separate line item; please confirm whether Acme needs VAT registration details on the invoice.
- PO / procurement: If you require a PO number on invoices, please confirm format and billing address.

I've attached the draft Order Form template we use internally; Laura (legal) and Neha (finance) are looped in to confirm language and invoicing details. If this captures what we discussed, I'll have a redlined Order Form back to you by Monday.

Attachments: OF_Redwood_draft_v2.docx (pricing schedule placeholder)

Next steps: can you confirm: (1) acceptance of the 6-month minimum at the proposed level, (2) whether Net 45 for 12 months is acceptable, and (3) the billing address / PO requirements?

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.com

From: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Reyes <m.reyes@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 14:04:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form commercial terms — minimum commits & invoicing cadence

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from procurement/legal:

1) Net terms: Net 45 for the first 12 months would work for finance, but legal needs to review language around late payment interest and what constitutes "payment" (wire vs ACH).
2) Taxes: Acme is in the US but we have a VAT entity for EMEA. Can Redwood include our VAT ID when invoicing for EU usage? We'll confirm the VAT number if you can add an invoice field.
3) PO: Yes, we will issue a PO. Format is ACME-PO-YYYY-####. Billing address and remit details are in the attached PO template. Please include a line in the OF confirming that invoices reference the PO.

I've attached the procurement PO template for your finance team to review. Also looping Mark (legal) to signal he'll send counters to any redlines from Laura.

Best,

Samantha Holt
Sr. Procurement Manager | AcmeHealth
samantha.holt@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4321
Attachment: Acme_PO_template.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 10:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form commercial terms — minimum commits & invoicing cadence

Samantha — perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and the PO template — that helps a lot. Quick responses inline: 

- Net terms: We'll accept Net 45 for the first 12 months. Redwood's standard late payment interest is 1.5% per month (18% APR) — Laura, can you confirm this is acceptable to include or suggest alternative phrasing?
- VAT: We can include a VAT field on invoices. Please send the EMEA VAT ID when you have it; for now we'll include a placeholder in the sample invoice.
- PO reference: We'll add a clause that "Customer's purchase orders referencing the Order Form will be acknowledged and the PO number must appear on all invoices."
- Minimum commits: We'll draft the 6-month minimum with a month-4 review clause; any consumption above committed will be billed at the Tier B overage rate (we'll show exact USD rates in the redline).

Laura and Neha — can you review the attached OF draft and the PO template for billing alignment? If you both sign off, I'll produce a redline for Acme and provide a DocuSign powerform link for countersignature.

Thanks — I'll aim to have the redline by EOD Monday.

Cheers,

Ben
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:05:02 -0700
Subject: RE: Order form commercial terms — minimum commits & invoicing cadence

Team — reviewed Ben's draft (thanks). High-level legal notes and proposed redlines attached. Key points for procurement negotiation: 

1) Payment terms / late fees: Suggest we soften to "past due amounts will accrue interest at the lesser of 1.5% per month or the maximum rate permitted by law." This helps avoid unconscionability challenges for certain jurisdictions.
2) Tax clause: Keep customer-responsible language but add standard cooperation language: "Customer will provide applicable tax exemption certificates where relevant." Also include Redwood's W-9 and tax details in schedule for US invoicing.
3) Invoicing and PO: Add an "Invoice Requirements" schedule: must include PO number, VAT/Tax ID (if applicable), billing contact, and remit instructions. We should also specify a single billing address for legal purposes.
4) Minimum commit termination: Add a provision allowing Redwood to convert unused committed credits to a carry-forward bank for up to one quarter if both parties agree in writing; otherwise unused credits are forfeited. This is negotiable — Priyom, confirm commercial acceptability.
5) Confidentiality / audit rights: Procurement asked about audit/evidence for usage; keep audit window limited to 12 months with reasonable notice.

I've attached OF_Redwood_v3_redline.docx with tracked changes and draft language for the above. Once we have Acme's counters, we'll run a final pass for signatures and DocuSign.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-2080
Attachment: OF_Redwood_v3_redline.docx

From: Mark Reyes <m.reyes@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Order form commercial terms — minimum commits & invoicing cadence

Ben / Samantha / Laura — thanks for the clarity and the redline. A few items from legal at Acme: 

- Net terms: Acme legal is comfortable with Net 45 for the first 12 months provided Redwood adopts Laura's "lesser of 1.5% or max permitted by law" language for late fees.
- VAT & invoicing: Confirmed — Acme will provide the EMEA VAT ID by Friday. Please add a VAT field and our VAT number to all EU invoices. Also provide your US tax details (W-9) on the invoice schedule.
- PO and billing: We'll issue PO ACME-PO-2026-1147. Please ensure invoices reference the PO number and email invoices to ap@acmehealth.com and cc: procurement.
- Minimum commit carry-forward: Acme prefers a 2-month carry-forward window rather than a full quarter. If Redwood can accept a 2-month carry-forward of unused credits, we can proceed to countersign.

If Redwood can accept the 2-month carry-forward change, toggle the late fee language as suggested, and produce the final OF with the PO number pre-populated, we'll sign via DocuSign. Linking here our countersign request: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234.

Please send the final redline with the PO filled and I'll route to procurement for signature.

Regards,

Mark Reyes
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | AcmeHealth
mark.reyes@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-1188
Attachment: Acme_Countersigned_MSA_snippet.pdf
